goal: Preserve corpus composition insight after shard capture failure
body: Dave clarified that most NouGen shards are arXiv papers, documentation, and other technical knowledge captured to elevate his systems. Treat the grid as both personal continuity and a compact engineering research corpus. Storage comparisons should emphasize that a relatively small disk footprint can hold a large body of reusable technical knowledge, provenance, methods, architecture lessons, and personal context. Shard capture attempt from ChatGPT failed with a forward HTTPError, so this relay is the fallback persistence path.

relay.note: Preserved the corpus-composition insight in relay-audit/2026-09-04-oldest-first.md with an evidence guard: the grid serves personal continuity and a compact engineering research corpus, but storage comparisons must disclose what was counted and cannot infer composition from size alone. This closes the fallback persistence scope; it does not claim shard capture recovered.
